title: The Dual-Track Soul Edge
summary: The Azure Sky elite course of two edges of soul force worked on separate lines that close together on the foe's will.

title: The Twin Court Ordeal of Will
summary: The Azure Sky elite ordeal of weighing a foe's will in the balance of two judges and passing a verdict of force.

title: Azure Hawk's Reach
summary: The Azure Sky elite teaching of the hawk's long sight and falling strike carried over to soul force at great reach.

title: The Basin Reckoning of the Soul River
summary: The Azure Sky elite reckoning that fills the will like a basin and lets the soul river run out in full flood.

title: Canon of the Paired Lance and Guard
summary: The Azure Sky elite canon that teaches the soul lance and the soul guard as one pair that cover each other.

title: Canon of the Sworn Heading
summary: The Gale elite canon of swearing a heading and driving the soul along it without turning aside for any blow.

title: Treatise of the Long Bearing
summary: The Gale elite treatise on striking the soul of a distant foe along a bearing taken and held across great reach.

title: The Wind-Sworn Unmaking
summary: The Gale elite rite of swearing the soul to the wind and letting the wind take apart whatever will it meets.

title: The Oath of the Open Mind
summary: The Gale elite oath of keeping nothing hidden in the mind so soul force passes freely and lays a foe's will bare.

title: The Edge-of-the-Wind Discipline
summary: The Gale elite discipline of riding the very edge of the wind with the soul and cutting from the gap it leaves.
